0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons, 2-0 and first in the Central and first in the East, visit the Philadelphia 76ers, who are 3-0 and first in the Atlantic, in the Pistons' third game of the 2026-27 season. Detroit is missing Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (heel), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 116-93 road win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
